Mori

Villa in Bang Jo
HomeNew ProjectsMori

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A village-style collection of two-storey modern pool villas in the Si Sunthon / Bang Jo area. The 3BR plan has parking, living, dining and kitchen downstairs, with a master suite, two bedrooms and a multi-purpose room upstairs.

  • Clubhouse
  • Fitness center
  • Swimming pool
  • Private garden
  • CCTV
  • 24-hour security
  • Children's playground
  • Coworking space
  • Cafe
  • Covered parking
  • Restaurant
  • Convenience shop
